name: workspace-docs-registry
purpose: Defines the categorized _docs structure and the checks that prevent durable workspace documentation from being missed or placed in the wrong folder.

reader_guide.summary: Open this file before adding or moving workspace-level documentation. It explains which category owns each type of document and which audit command catches missing or misplaced docs.
how_to_read: Read categories to choose the target folder.
Read root_file_policy before adding anything directly under _docs.
Read required_documents to see the minimum docs that future agents must not lose.
Run audit_command after moving, adding, or deleting files under _docs.
update_triggers: A durable workspace document is added, moved, renamed, or deleted.
A required policy, instruction, operating model, or governance document changes path.
The docs audit command starts missing real gaps or reporting false positives.

reference_links.title: Diataxis Documentation Framework
used_for: separating documentation by user need and document purpose

reference_links.title: Google Developer Documentation Style Guide
used_for: consistent technical documentation style and reference use

structure_rules.rule: Every durable Markdown document under _docs must live in one of the registered category folders unless it is an allowed root index file.
structure_rules.reason: Root-level document sprawl makes important rules hard to find and easy to miss.

structure_rules.rule: Every category folder must include Korean and English README index files.
structure_rules.reason: A human should be able to open each folder and know what belongs there.

structure_rules.rule: Files ending in .ko.md or .en.md under _docs must have the opposite-language companion unless explicitly exempted.
structure_rules.reason: The user asked important durable docs to be available in both Korean and English.

structure_rules.rule: Required instruction, policy, operating-model, and governance documents must always exist at their registered paths.
structure_rules.reason: Future agents should not lose the minimum durable operating context as documents move.

structure_rules.rule: Run docs-audit after changing _docs, docs registry, durable docs paths, or docs category rules.
structure_rules.reason: A deterministic check catches omissions before they become hidden context loss.

field_guide.meaning: Registered document categories with paths, include patterns, and required README files.
Minimum durable docs that must exist for future agents.
Rules for requiring Korean and English companion files.
Command that checks the registry against the file tree.

categories.purpose: Durable user instructions and baseline workspace rules.
Conceptual operating models for platform, context, and assistant runtime behavior.
Cross-cutting governance for repository structure and capability promotion.
